description: Utility functions for handling ingredients, units, foods, and recipes in a cooking/recipe application.

methods.name: ingredientToString
methods.description: Converts an Ingredient object into a human-readable string representation.

methods.name: ingredientToFoodString
methods.description: Returns a string for the food part of an ingredient, pluralized if necessary.

methods.name: pluralString
methods.description: Determines the correct plural or singular name for a Food or Unit object based on amount.

methods.name: ingredientToUnitString
methods.description: Returns the unit name for an ingredient, pluralized if needed.

methods.name: getRecipeIngredients
methods.description: Extracts and returns all ingredients used in a recipe, optionally including step headers.
